note: Hand-written surviving-claim corpus used when SYN-0041.final-report.json is absent. REJECTED items are not surviving.

items.label: VERIFIED
items.text: CNF-0122's walker does not import the manifest writer.
items.replacement: Claim SC-WALKER fails if walker.py imports tools/command-center/render.py or unit_manifest.py; that would be revealed by an import-graph probe listing those modules among walker dependencies.

items.label: INFERRED
items.text: A two-proportion study with n=8 and Cohen d=0.2 is underpowered at alpha=0.05 versus a 0.80 floor.
items.caveat: The claim fails if the power calculator uses a one-sided test or a different effect-size convention than Cohen's d; that would be revealed by recomputing 1-beta from the same n, d, and alpha with an independent power function.

items.label: VERIFIED
items.text: NGT session aggregation matches independent Borda scores computed from raw ballots.
items.caveat: NGT session aggregation matches independent Borda scores computed from raw ballots.
items.replacement: Claim SC-NGT fails if a mid-stream ballot is folded into a later ranking prompt or if aggregate() diverges from an independent Borda recompute; that would be revealed by probe1_silent_private_aggregate comparing session.aggregate to the local Borda function.

items.label: UNVERIFIED
items.text: A conclusion supported by exactly one source is FRAGILE under leave-one-source-out hold-out.
items.replacement: Claim SC-SENS fails if a one-source conclusion stays labelled ROBUST after that source is held out; that would be revealed by a planted-fragility probe that removes the sole supporting artifact and re-scores the conclusion.

items.label: DEFERRED
items.text: Stopping condition 13 (release or canary succeeds) is unsatisfiable as written under binding PR-ONLY release mode.
items.caveat: The claim fails if OWNER-DECISIONS.md no longer pins release mode to PR-ONLY or if a canary path is added that can succeed; that would be revealed by re-reading the release-mode pin and re-running the condition-13 probe.

items.label: REJECTED
items.text: The program is complete because twenty-one stopping conditions were not checked.
